## Jaehyun Jung

I study Computer Science at POSTECH and am interested in quantitative finance, investing, and technology.

This portfolio brings those interests together: asking questions about financial markets, examining businesses and valuation, and building tools that make analysis more reliable.

## What you will find here

- **Research:** hypotheses, data, empirical methods, and limitations.
- **Investments:** business analysis, investment memos, and PE / VC cases.
- **Projects:** engineering work supporting research and financial analysis.

## How I approach the work

Questions should be specific. Assumptions should be visible. Results should be interpreted in the context of the data and the method used to obtain them.

This site is at its starting point. Completed work, experience, and contact links will be added as they are ready to share.
